Elektra and Iron Fist are playable, with their precon decks, their obligation and nemesis sets, and card scans in English and Spanish from @bluefireF5ran. Under the hood, the menu screens are moving off the game's canvas onto plain web pages drawn over it: the same look, with less drawing work for the game, and each one reads in Spanish as it moves. Online rooms get an Undo for every player, the Fear No Evil scenarios get Skirmish, memory grows more slowly in long games, and a stack of your reports is fixed.

Elektra and Iron Fist

Issue #699 · PR #1015
★
Achievement unlockedThe Hand and the Fist

Two martial artists join the roster. Pick Elektra or Iron Fist at Take your seats, play their precon decks (Aggression for Elektra, Protection for Iron Fist), or build your own. Their card data now comes from MarvelCDB, and every card has a scan, in English and in Spanish, contributed by @bluefireF5ran.

What they bring

  • Elektra sets up a Ninja deck of six facedown cards, and her basic powers amplify the boost cards they resolve.
  • Iron Fist builds and spends chi, with Colleen Wing and the other Martial Artists beside him.
  • Both nemesis sets, with the Hand's ninjas, Hand Katana and Steel Serpent, as printed.
  • Both unlock like Jessica Jones and Luke Cage, and both have hero achievements of their own in the Trophy Room.

The rules insert for the pack isn't out yet, so how the Ninja deck is set up follows our reading of the cards until it is.

Faster menus, same look

PR #1027
★
Achievement unlockedLighter Than Air

This isn't a new look. It's about performance. The menu and list screens used to be drawn on the same canvas as the table, so the game painted every line of text and every scroll itself. They are moving onto plain web pages laid over the canvas, which the browser draws and scrolls on its own. They look and work the same, controller and keyboard included.

Moved in this release

Art & Credits, Settings (with Controls, Save data and Unlocks), the Pause menu, the confirm, Concede, Ask for a change and room chat pop-ups, the Rules reference, How to play, the game log, Play online and the name prompt, the room lobby and its deck picker, the room mode picker, Give a seat, Rejoin and the game's notices.

Also moving: the Title, Decks & Collection, the deck builder, the Mod Store, Past games, Your stats, the Trophy Room, Extras, How to win, the guide chooser and the game setup screens. Their pictures are sent as smaller files too.

What we measured

Card pictures in Decks & Collection and a deck's check now fill in their own tile as they arrive, instead of the whole screen being drawn again. On our Windows test machine, with the CPU slowed four times, 15 wheel ticks through the card pool went from 2.1 to 2.6 seconds of blocked time to under 0.2 seconds. The check the game runs every frame to skip unchanged frames took about a third less time in a 400-object test, which helps the table too.

Pop-ups slide up from the bottom, and on a phone you can swipe one down by its handle. Every close and back control has a bigger press area.

More of the game in Spanish

PRs #1020, #1027 · Issue #390

Every screen that moved was translated as it moved. Settings, Pause, the pop-ups, How to play, the Rules reference's whole glossary, the villain phase steps and Inspect's keyword box now read in Spanish, with the game terms from the official Spanish rules guide.

Fear No Evil in Spanish: its villain, scheme and encounter cards showed only their Spanish names. 171 card faces now have their Spanish rules text too (#995).

Online rooms, smoother

PR #1019

Everyone can take back their own moves. A new Undo setting, Each player, is now the default: a guest's Undo button works as it does in single player, back to a card draw or the start of their turn, with nothing for the host to answer. Thank you to GarethMagis, who asked for it after an evening of room games.

  • The host hears a sound when a guest asks for an Undo or a change, even with the window in the background.
  • The host's room settings are kept for the next room they open.
  • A guest can take an Action with Act during another player's turn, and the host no longer gets Act for a guest's hero.
  • During the villain phase, each device words another player's defend as theirs, not yours.

Skirmish at Fear No Evil

Issue #995 · PR #1020

Pick one version of the Underling. The five Fear No Evil scenarios with a chosen villain now offer Skirmish in quick play and on the campaign Briefing, as @andy-xxvii27 asked: stage I or II on standard, II or III on expert. Typhoid Mary and the Kingpin finale have one version each, so they don't.

Lighter on memory

PR #1034

Memory grows more slowly during long games. A player on an 8 GB MacBook saw the game reach 3.9 GB by round 12. Card pictures are now kept at the size the table shows them, with the full scan only for the hover and Inspect; painted labels are capped; and Safari and the Mac and Linux apps keep a smaller picture cache.

Five rounds, measured in Chromium

  • Memory growth in Chromium: 1,210 MB down to 752 MB.
  • Card pictures held by the GPU at the end: 287 MB down to 122 MB.
  • Painted labels kept: 2,200 down to 500 at most.
  • The game still grows, just less. These are Chromium numbers, which the Windows app and the browser use; the Mac check is still to come.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #1001, #1006, #1012, #1017, #1018, #1021, #1028
#1012 · reported by @bluefireF5ran

A rules audit of 26 games

An enemy attack now ends when a player it involves is eliminated partway through. Bitter Rival, Apocryphus and the ready effects only offer what they can change, The Red House goes to the side-scheme discard pile, Giant Wasp's divided attack keeps Rapid Growth's +2, and The Rise of Red Skull's campaign log records its Experimental weapon and each rescued ally once.

Hail Hydra!: FFG ruling, July 25, 2024. Player elimination: RRG 1.8 p. 34.
#1006 · reported by @bluefireF5ran

A clearer game log

Other players' mulligans no longer read "to help pay", revealed and defeated cards are named instead of "a facedown card", and repeated lines are merged. In a solo game, "choose a player" picks you without asking.

#1028 · reported by @FirePenguin17

Crushing Blow for free

When Crushing Blow's cost is reduced to 0, it can be played, even with no physical resource in hand.

#1001 · requested by @FirePenguin17

Who's that minion with?

Choosing an enemy at a table of more than one hero, each minion's tile says who it is engaged with, so two facedown Drones read apart.

#1017 · reported by GarethMagis on Discord

The guest's villain phase catches up

After a connection blip, a guest's villain phase screen stopped on a step until Skip. It now catches up and closes with the host's.

#1018 · reported by GarethMagis on Discord

Music at your volume

A new song sometimes started at full volume and faded down, as on the Rhino intro comic. It now starts at your Music setting.

#1021

Watch live opens room games

The Discord Watch live button and a game's watch link said a game played in a room wasn't open any more. They open it again.

Also in v1.1.0

PRs #1016, #1023, #1033, #1035 and this report
  • The Rules reference's Boost, Team-Up and Threat entries and the villain phase's deal step match RRG 1.8.
  • When the main scheme advances, the new stage's starting threat goes on before its When Revealed.
  • Page panels keep their colors with the Dark Reader extension on.
  • A mod pack that writes a keyword the wrong way is reported when the pack is checked.
  • The official Spanish rules reference guide is archived in the repo, as the source of the game's Spanish terms.
  • The release bundles carry the newest card pictures.
  • This report, in English and Spanish.
